root_review.method: Viewed full-page paired color and grayscale copies, 720 pixels per page, from hash-verified original 150 dpi PDF renders. Also inspected original color introduction and Chapter 19 opening and grayscale final credits.

delegated_review.method: Agent reported viewing original color and grayscale page renders before the usage limit interrupted its final report. These observations were received in the root session; the aggregate receipt records their provenance. Root completed every remaining sample.

findings: Revised instructions, paragraph boundaries, headings and list markers are legible, with no clipped text or overlapping content in reviewed pages.
Retained recent illustrations and practical diagrams remain clear in grayscale, with readable labels and captions.
Appendix D item 7 continues over the page with two lines before the ledger heading; the complete revised sentence remains readable.
Appendix E keeps Tier 0 together before the next page illustration; the open lower page area follows the preserved figure grouping.
Physical pages 104 and 182 are intentional blank versos before right-hand Part II and Part III openings.
Chapter 19 begins at physical page 322. Its contents entry, opening title and preceding chapter close agree.
Credits remain inside the page boundaries through physical page 410.
scope: Targeted visual inspection of 42 physical pages in each of two PDF editions, covering every recorded editorial change, retained recent art, front matter, transitions and credits. Automated whole-document text/resource checks are separate. This does not assert a visual inspection of every page or a physical print proof.
